tool.name: Download reference genomes (GTDB) for SemiBin
tool.command: #if $type == "test" mkdir -p '${out_file.extra_files_path}' && touch '${out_file.extra_files_path}'/empty && #else SemiBin2 download_GTDB --reference-db-data-dir '${out_file.extra_files_path}' && #end if cp '$dmjson' '$out_file'
tool.help:
Download the GTDB reference database used by SemiBin ====================================================
SemiBin @TOOL_VERSION@ always downloads the same immutable archive, ``GTDB_@GTDB_VERSION@.tar.gz``, from `Zenodo record 4751564 <https://zenodo.org/records/4751564>`_ (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4751564, published 2021-05-12, md5 ``4a70301c54104e87d5615e3f2383c8b5``, about 24 GB) and verifies its MD5 after the download.
The database is installed as ``semibin/data/gtdb_@GTDB_VERSION@`` and is recorded in the ``gtdb`` data table with the stable identifier ``GTDB_@GTDB_VERSION@``.
